title: [ingest] C domain had O(n) Symbol child lookup from 3.0 to ~7.3; now uses dicts
summary: From Sphinx 3.0, `Symbol._children` was a list, making `_find_named_symbols` a linear scan — a significant performance regression vs 2.x. Fixed by replacing `_children` with two dicts: `_children_by_name` and `_children_by_docname`. Extensions that directly accessed `Symbol._children` as a list will break after this change.
